en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning reissued after midnight with Thunderstorm Warning still in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the Amber Rainstorm Warning shortly after midnight and has the Thunderstorm Warning extended until 3 a.m., expecting heavy rain and squally thunderstorms under an active southerly…
body: The Hong Kong Observatory reissued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at midnight on Thursday, indicating that heavy rain exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour has fallen or is expected generally over Hong Kong and is likely to continue.

The Thunderstorm Warning, first issued at 5:20 a.m. on Wednesday, remains in force and has been extended until 3 a.m. on Thursday. A few squally thunderstorms are expected, with intense gusts reaching 70 kilometres per hour or above possible.

The Observatory said an active southerly airstream is bringing frequent showers and thunderstorms. Members of the public in low-lying or poorly drained areas were advised to take precautions against flooding, stay away from watercourses, and seek safe shelter if outdoors during thunderstorms.

zh.headline: 午夜後再發黃色暴雨警告 雷暴警告延長至凌晨3時
zh.dek: 天文台午夜過後再發出黃色暴雨警告，雷暴警告延長至今日凌晨3時，預料受活躍偏南氣流影響，本港有大雨及狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台於周四午夜再發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。
於周三上午5時20分發出的雷暴警告仍然生效，並已延長至周四凌晨3時。預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴，並可能出現時速70公里或以上的強陣風。
天文台表示，受活躍偏南氣流影響，本港有頻繁驟雨及雷暴。低窪或排水欠佳地區的市民應採取預防措施以防水浸，遠離河道，雷暴期間如身處戶外應盡快到安全地方躲避。
